robots.name: Franka Emika Panda + head camera mast (spec §9 rev. 2026-10-01)
robots.source_url: https://github.com/frankarobotics/franka_ros (franka_description); same copy bundled in Isaac Sim 5.1 isaacsim.asset.importer.urdf/data/urdf/robots/franka_description (package.xml <license>Apache 2.0</license>)

head_camera.defined: mast fixed to panda_link0 (robot body), not official

default.model: RealSense D435 colour, hfov 69 deg, rendered 672x376, fx=fy=489

wrist_cameras: D405 on panda_hand (hfov 87 deg, 424x240), beside the hand looking at the finger tips
robots.hand: Franka Hand parallel gripper, 0.08 m max opening
robots.isaac_asset: URDF -> Isaac Lab UrdfConverter (USD made on /data); the Nucleus Franka USD is not used
robots.why: user-log 236/237: arms without an official head camera are allowed with a body-fixed head camera mount whose pose / angles / intrinsics are stated and recorded per episode

robots.name: Galaxea R1 Pro (GalaxeaManipSim)

head_camera.link: zed_link, fixed to torso_link4 (xyz 0.065511 0.060003 0.47598, rpy -1.9199 0 -1.5708); 4 torso joints move it

robots.why: official Galaxea organisation repo with an Apache-2.0 LICENSE; ZED head + two wrist RealSense in the URDF

robots.name: Unitree G1
robots.licence: BSD 3-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2016-2022 HangZhou YuShu TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD. ("Unitree Robotics")

head_camera.link: d435_link (+ mid360_link lidar), fixed joint parented to torso_link; NOTE: no separate neck/head DOF, camera is rigidly head-height-mounted on torso

robots.arm_dof: 7 DOF x2 (g1_29dof variant); 5 DOF x2 (g1_23dof variant)
robots.hand: variant-dependent: Dex3 3-finger hand, Inspire/Dex1 5-finger hand, or no hand (bare wrist flange); Dex3/Inspire variants support top-down pinch grasp
robots.isaac_asset: Yes - Unitree G1 is an official Isaac Lab batteries-included humanoid asset (isaaclab_assets G1 config)
robots.why: BSD-3-Clause OK; d435 head camera officially defined at head height in URDF; dexterous hand variants enable pinch grasp; already has first-class Isaac Lab support

robots.name: Unitree H1 (base, no hand)
robots.licence: BSD 3-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2016-2022 HangZhou YuShu TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

head_camera.link: d435_left_imager_link / d435_rgb_module_link + mid360_link, fixed to torso_link; no neck DOF

robots.arm_dof: 4 DOF per arm, ends in bare flange (no gripper) in the base h1.urdf
robots.hand: none in official base URDF -> top-down pinch NOT feasible without an unverified/unofficial hand add-on
robots.isaac_asset: Yes - Unitree H1 is an official Isaac Lab batteries-included humanoid asset, but only the handless locomotion config
robots.why: Head camera is fine and license is fine, but the official URDF has no gripper/hand, so it cannot do pinch-grasp manipulation; superseded here by H1-2 which adds a hand

robots.name: Unitree H1-2
robots.licence: BSD 3-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2016-2022 HangZhou YuShu TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

head_camera.link: camera_link, fixed joint parented to torso_link; no separate neck DOF

robots.arm_dof: 7 DOF per arm (h1_2_with_FTP_hand.urdf variant); handless variant also provided
robots.hand: FTP dexterous hand (with-hand variant) enables top-down pinch grasp
robots.isaac_asset: Unknown/unconfirmed - Isaac Lab ships the base H1 (4-DOF, handless) config officially; the 7-DOF+hand H1-2 variant was not found in the official isaaclab_assets list as checked
robots.why: BSD-3-Clause OK; camera_link head camera officially defined; FTP hand variant gives genuine pinch-grasp capability that base H1 lacks

robots.name: Fourier GR1 / GR2
robots.source_url: https://github.com/FFTAI/Wiki-GRx-Models (Wiki-GRx-URDF redirects here); Apache-2.0 Wiki-GRx-MJCF repo exists but only ships the N1 model, not GR1/GR2
robots.wrist_cameras: unknown - not verified because the only official GR1/GR2 description repo fails the license gate
robots.why: The only official GR1/GR2 URDF/MJCF repo (Wiki-GRx-Models) is GPL-3.0, which is copyleft and not on the approved licence list; the Apache-2.0 Wiki-GRx-MJCF repo only covers the N1 model, not GR1/GR2, so no in-list licence covers GR1/GR2; re-checked 2026-10-01: the Isaac Sim GR-1 USD is under the '3D Content Sharing Agreement' (not on the list) -> still excluded, replacement = Unitree G1

robots.name: Galaxea R1
robots.licence: No LICENSE file found in repo root or default branch; GitHub license API returns no match

head_camera.defined: likely (per official hardware guide: 1x ZED2 binocular depth head camera), exact URDF link name not verified because the repo fails the licence gate

wrist_cameras: per official hardware guide: 2x RealSense D405/D435i monocular depth wrist cameras (one per arm); exact URDF link names not verified
robots.why: Hardware design (head + dual wrist cameras) looks ideal, but the official URDF repo has no LICENSE file / terms anywhere -> unclear licence, fails the hard requirement; see 'Galaxea R1 Pro (GalaxeaManipSim)' for an Apache-2.0 official source

robots.name: Booster T1

head_camera.link: head_realsense_rgb_link, parented to aahead_pitch_link (which hangs off aahead_yaw_link) - a genuine 2-DOF articulated neck

robots.arm_dof: ~7 DOF per arm (shoulder x3, elbow x2, wrist x2-3 identified in T1_29dof.urdf)
robots.hand: parallel 2-finger gripper available (T1_23dof_parallel variant); top-down pinch feasible
robots.isaac_asset: Not in Isaac Lab's official batteries-included list (only G1/H1 humanoids are); Booster ships its own Isaac Gym/MuJoCo RL assets, not an Isaac Lab manipulation asset
robots.why: BSD-3-Clause OK; one of the few candidates with a truly articulated (moving) neck carrying the camera; parallel-gripper variant supports pinch grasp

robots.name: PAL Robotics TIAGo

head_camera.link: head_front_camera (Asus Xtion Pro Live or Orbbec Astra RGBD, selectable), parented to head_2_link, a 2-DOF pan/tilt head

robots.hand: PAL parallel 2-finger gripper, or Hey5 underactuated hand variant; top-down pinch feasible
robots.isaac_asset: Not in Isaac Lab's official batteries-included list (Franka/UR10/Allegro/Shadow + G1/H1 only); PAL provides a separate Isaac Sim extension, not core Isaac Lab
robots.why: Apache-2.0 OK; head_front_camera explicitly defined on an articulated head; gripper variant supports pinch grasp. Caveat: single-arm only, unlike the bimanual FFW-SG2

robots.name: PAL Robotics TALOS
robots.commit_or_date: unknown exact last-push date (not confirmed in this session)

head_camera.link: rgbd sensor (Orbbec Astra Pro, name '${name}_2' i.e. head_2) parented to head_2_link, a 2-DOF neck; optional Intel D435 / T265 / OS1-64 lidar also definable on the same link

robots.hand: PAL parallel 1-DOF gripper per arm (urdf/gripper folder); top-down pinch feasible, bimanual
robots.isaac_asset: unknown - not found in Isaac Lab's official batteries-included list
robots.why: Apache-2.0 OK; dual 7-DOF arms + grippers + articulated head RGBD camera is the closest match in form factor to the bimanual FFW-SG2 among all candidates found. Found during search, not in the original named list, but satisfies the spec directly; added as a recommended candidate

robots.name: Hello Robot Stretch 3
robots.licence: The Clear BSD License, Copyright (c) 2021-2024 Hello Robot Inc. (BSD-family permissive licence; adds an explicit no-patent-grant clause beyond plain BSD-3-Clause, commercial use allowed)

head_camera.link: D435i camera mounted on the articulated pan/tilt head (head_pan / head_tilt joints); official link commonly named camera_link / camera_bottom_screw_frame

robots.hand: parallel 1-DOF gripper; top-down pinch grasp is Stretch's standard manipulation mode
robots.isaac_asset: No official Isaac Lab asset found; Stretch is commonly used in Habitat/PyBullet/Gazebo rather than Isaac Lab's batteries-included list
robots.why: Licence is a permissive BSD variant (flagged for user awareness, not plain BSD-3-Clause); D435i head camera explicitly defined on an articulated pan/tilt head in the official URDF. Caveat: single arm only, different form factor from bimanual FFW-SG2

robots.name: RB-Y1 (Rainbow Robotics)
robots.wrist_cameras: unknown - not verified; likely added by integrators only, not official
robots.hand: various end-effector examples (gripper models included); top-down pinch feasible
robots.isaac_asset: RainbowRobotics/rby1-sim-isaac exists (3 stars) - an official Isaac Sim integration repo, but it does not resolve the missing camera definition
robots.why: Licence and arms are ideal, but the official URDF's head_mount joint is explicitly commented out (child link literally named 'Arbitrary device') and no camera appears in the MJCF model either -> no active head camera frame is defined in the official description, failing the core requirement as written

robots.name: Kepler Forerunner K2 / other Kepler models
robots.why: No official open-source URDF/MJCF/USD repository could be located via GitHub search for any Kepler humanoid; appears closed-source, so licence and camera definitions cannot be verified

robots.name: AgiBot X2
robots.licence: Mulan Permissive Software License v2 (木兰宽松许可证，第2版) - OSI-approved, Apache-2.0-like permissive grant of copyright + patent, no copyleft

head_camera.defined: not verified in this pass (time-boxed); not confirmed

robots.why: Licence is functionally permissive and commercial-friendly, but Mulan PSL v2 is not on the user-approved whitelist (CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA/Apache-2.0/MIT/BSD); would need explicit user sign-off to add it before being usable, so excluded as-is rather than assumed

robots.name: iCub (robotology/icub-models, e.g. iCubGenova04)
robots.arm_dof: ~7 DOF x2 arms (iCub has dual arms with multi-finger hands)
robots.hand: iCub underactuated multi-finger hand; top-down pinch plausible
robots.why: Found during search, not in the original list. Licence is fine (CC BY-SA 4.0) and it has a moving head + dual hands, but the official model.urdf does not define an explicit camera/eye link - it only references an external YARP sensor config file ('gazebo_icub_head_without_eyes.ini') outside the URDF, so no head camera frame is defined in the URDF itself per the spec's requirement. Excluded rather than guessed.
